_readme: S402 SkyToyon, 2026-10-17. Five colleges the census filed as eLumen have never been read (the sweep's eLumen waves took nine others), and four of their registry rows name a page about the catalog or an old catalog: Porterville, Solano and West Valley name a college page; Mission names its 24-25 eLumen catalog under a 2026-2027 year; Santiago Canyon names sccollege.elumenapp.com/catalog/catalog/home under 2025-2026. Five loads, no model call: each page's catalog links, to find the 2026-2027 eLumen catalog each reader would start from. The registry rows change only through a correction Sam approves (S371's Mesa correction, Sheet 69 item 1).

questions.porterville: Porterville's 2026-2027 catalog: the href of its eLumen catalog (or PDF).
